privacySections: Screenshot Studio processes the images and project details you choose to provide so you can create store listing graphics. Contact form submissions include the name, email address, subject, and message you enter.
We use submitted information to operate the studio, respond to support requests, and improve the service. Contact messages are sent through EmailJS when the service is configured.

Project data may be stored in your browser to support the editor. Information submitted through the contact form is transmitted to EmailJS and handled according to its privacy terms. We do not sell personal information.
You can choose what information and images to provide. For questions about this policy or a contact submission, use our contact page.
We may update this policy as the service changes. The date above indicates when it was most recently revised.
termsSections: Screenshot Studio helps you prepare marketing images for app store listings. You are responsible for ensuring your use of the service follows applicable laws and the rules of the stores where you publish your images.

You retain responsibility for the screenshots, logos, text, and other materials you upload. You must have the rights needed to use those materials. Avoid uploading content you are not authorized to use.
Do not use the service to violate others' rights, distribute unlawful content, interfere with the service, or attempt to access systems without authorization.
The service is provided as available and may change over time. We may fix, update, or temporarily suspend features to maintain the service.
Questions about these terms can be sent through our contact page.

award-badge.label: Warm Editorial Cards
award-badge.description: A quiet ivory canvas and editable feature cards balance the app screenshot.

earthy-routine.label: Earthy Routine Rows
earthy-routine.description: A deep taupe title card and tidy routine rows give the listing a grounded, crafted feel.

split-bleed.label: Oversized Bleed / Split Caption
split-bleed.description: A compact upper caption makes room for a phone that continues cleanly beyond the canvas edge.

floating-widget.label: Minimalist Floating Widget
floating-widget.description: Quiet white space, crisp type, and a floating product widget add dimension to the device preview.

side-by-side-proof.label: Side-by-Side Feature Cards
side-by-side-proof.description: Two editable callouts flank the central phone preview.

bottom-banner-widget.label: Bottom Banner Notification
bottom-banner-widget.description: A broad notification banner overlaps the lower edge of a large centered phone.

split-sidecar-hero.label: Split Sidecar Hero
split-sidecar-hero.description: A compact text and feature column balances a large phone positioned on the right.

top-pill-story.label: Caption Stack
top-pill-story.description: An open caption block leads into an oversized phone preview and an optional callout.

fashion-festive-promo.label: Festive Promo
fashion-festive-promo.description: A restrained campaign canvas with gold details, generous headline space, and a large product preview.

fashion-panoramic-split.label: Panoramic Split
fashion-panoramic-split.description: A tilted phone crosses a soft, continuous fashion canvas.

fashion-editorial-grid.label: Editorial Collage
fashion-editorial-grid.description: A composed fashion campaign pairs an oversized app preview with two real screenshot panels and editable editorial copy.

fashion-promo-block.label: Promo Block
fashion-promo-block.description: A high impact campaign banner leads into the product screenshot.

fitness-dark-neon.label: Dark Neon
fitness-dark-neon.description: A charcoal training layout with athletic photography and an electric cyan device edge.

fitness-neon-dark.label: Fitness & Bodybuilding
fitness-neon-dark.description: Athletic photography, deep charcoal, and restrained olive accents frame the app preview.

fitness-log-cards.label: Workout Log Cards
fitness-log-cards.description: Exercise checkoff cards float above a strong phone preview.

edu-flashcard-stack.label: Academic Sticker Stack
edu-flashcard-stack.description: Academic sticker art frames editable course copy and a clean device preview.

edu-pastel-waves.label: Pastel Waves & Cards
edu-pastel-waves.description: Soft blue vector waves and stacked flashcards frame the learning app preview.

edu-institution-badges.label: Institution Badges
edu-institution-badges.description: A tilted left phone balances a neat grid of institution badges.

prod-minimal-widget.label: Product Focus
prod-minimal-widget.description: A quiet interface lets the uploaded app screen become the hero without a decorative device frame.

prod-split-bleed.label: Split Bleed
prod-split-bleed.description: An upper caption gives way to a dark developer screen bleeding off the lower edge.
